summary: An informative overview of how legacy applications can be made to work with the Host Identity Protocol (HIP). HIP adds a cryptographic name space for hosts, a new address family from the application's point of view, but it may take a long time before applications understand it. This document looks at ways to bridge the gap.

eli5.summary: A new kind of ID card is useless if old shops do not recognize it. This explains how to let older programs use the new ID system without rewriting them.
